title: MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - JURADO) relative to amending the List of Citywide Special Events.
text:
[Council File 26-1503; CD 3]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - JURADO) relative to amending the List of Citywide Special Events.
Recommendation for Council action:
INSTRUCT the Chief Legislative Analyst to include the following changes/amounts in the List of Citywide Special Events for Council District 3:
ADD – Lantern Festival - $15,000
